Introduction: 1 Part I Introduction

2 The threefold wisdom reveals its secrets, moving my mighty circles, they are keen and the desire of the nobles has brought me here to be a counselor, their name is engraved in my heart, pure and complete, with their kindness they fed me the fruit of a tree, its holiness is third in the world, my soul asks for a share of the stone, if God has a mouth then only I have kissed him:...

3 Introduction: Since (today) the knowledge of mankind is as diverse as the forms of their faces, it was necessary to give them from God, the Blessed One, who gives them their substance and form and who endowed them with science - gifts of leadership in general, gifts of leadership in turn, until there is a fixed order established in a just order in each generation according to a clear reality, and the general provision to give value to a single individual, because a man in our image is found, and that material man will be interpreted in his clarity according to what time will see that man, and sometimes time will be a king and a prophet, and sometimes it will happen that he will be a prophet alone or a king alone, and it is possible that there will be neither one nor the other, but there will be a power in them similar to this or that of both together, where we will see what has passed:

4 He who knows the truth of reality will be more humble and lowly in spirit than his fellow man, and indeed it was said of the master of all the prophets, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the man Moses was the humblest of all men on the face of the earth (Numbers 12:3). However, if he desires to be free, it will be his time in being free. He has become the machine of those who are free from the rest of the people, because everyone else besides him seeks power because he will rule over the people like a lion and devour, and he alone seeks power, so that the people will receive Torah and Mitzvot from him, and he will desire that all the people resemble him in wisdom, as it is said of the one through whom the Torah and Mitzvot were given, and who would give all the people of the Lord prophets, since the Lord would put His Spirit upon them (Numbers 11:29). And this has become the (layman) ruler, who will not desire that any man from among the people resemble him, and the Lord, blessed be He, likened the perfect man to Himself in that He also desires to complete man until he resembles Him, and this is the desire shared with the abundance that flows from Him upon man. They have invented tools that make people easily cling to it:

5 And the book is the written one written in the book, and it directs the (waters) [truth] that is found and considered in the heart, and it invented the heart and the mind in thought, and these are the good deeds that the external ones were necessary for him and for others to fulfill his external objects, and the writing because sometimes it was necessary for him to calculate everything that he would say about him, was and is and will be, in order to complete himself and his own thought in that thought, and all this will be fulfilled in the giving of the Torah, the rules that God gave to specify the people who are worthy of Him, blessed be He:

6 And indeed, the gift for the individual is what was bought from there for every living being to speak individually, and from which we are influenced and become also for others, the living being to speak for the living being to speak and our number according to what is felt and weighed, which is true without a doubt, and God has granted me a little knowledge in His great mercy, blessed be He. We also desired Him to be like Him and to give from His knowledge this to the one who is worthy of receiving it, when we brought to Him the desire of His love, when He would come to shelter under the shadow of the wings of the Shekhinah to receive something from the Supreme Wisdom:

7 Therefore, I, the young man Nathiel ben Raziel [in the generation of Abraham], son of (Sheli"i) Shluyel [in the generation of Samuel], and I wrote this book called the Book of Desire for a Man Who Desires His Desire, Saadia bar Yitzhak, and with him in his company was a young man drawn to his mind and will, Yaakov bar Avraham in the island of Askaliya in the state of Sinai, the nice young man who is remembered for coming to seek wisdom with a terrible desire. His soul desired it, and I did not find in any instrument of desire to give it to him in a gift that I know would be more pleasing in his eyes than this book, and therefore I called it by the name of the Desire to embrace in it the desire that we have built for the honor of God, the Blessed One, and when (Naton) [Naatiu] [Naatiu] was prepared, this is the object that is good for me, in particular, it also happened to be useful to others, as we hinted in the secret of reality, because the divine abundance that comes to us intentionally, in the spirit of many to receive the good of the instruments of the disposition of abundance from the eternal abundance, and so this book and the like should have in them the beginning of a special intention and it is To the special, and from there the meaning will spread to the many:

8 And now you will know that the instruments of intercourse were sufficient for the invention of the species born from them, but because they needed another helper, God gave them the appropriate helper, and likewise the instruments of thought were sufficient for achievement, but because they needed a helper, God gave them all the helpers, and likewise the complete man was sufficient for the world, but he will not be found without helpers, and will still be formed and lost, therefore all his helpers were given to him and personal powers were prepared in the persons to create him after the one formation that is destined to be lost, so that in each generation there would not be a lack of one or many complete men, for if this were lacking, human reality would be in vain, and therefore the righteous and the pious and the sages and the prophets and their like were found so that the world would be complete, and when the man is complete - the small world would also be complete. And I intended in this book to complete the small world mentioned and its likenesses:

9 And I divided it into three parts that are hinted at in rhymes because my whole intention was to speak in the secrets of the Holy God, the Triple One, in the letters that await the wise of heart, and the bringer of abundance, the educated in body and soul and mind, and in the form of the sun and moon and stars:

19 A heart is full and threefold. In one, the name has established a special and imbued with an important fear, the name of the one who is expressed:

Every single person amongst human beings hopes. And were it not that he hopes for something in the future, all of his thoughts, actions, and words would be for naught. However, since he does hope and await for the goal of the thoughts of his hope, he does think many thoughts, performs actions, and speaks words, so that he will come to the goal of his hope. But his hopes are also not [all] equal. Rather, they are on all sorts of various levels that differ very very much from one another. And this difference is generated by desire and by thought.

However, no sage has any desire besides that for wisdom and anything that leads to it, just like no fool has any desire besides that for laziness. So there is already a big disagreement between these two extremes: For one is truly most lofty, and the other is, without a doubt, most lowly. And the disagreement is that the fool will praise foolish matters. That is, even though he will not call them foolish, since the word foolish for him is also commonly agreed to indicate lowliness. However, he will change the name of foolishness and call it something else, which indicates something lofty to him. That is like someone who whores does not call his action evil, but instead calls it a great delight for himself.  Likewise, the fool will call foolishness knowledge and understanding, according to how his lowly thinking will formulate [them]. Yet because the sage [knows] that he is very much lacking the righteousness to describe the true value of wisdom, he is only able to praise it with comparisons beneath its actual value. If so, behold that the intentions are the opposite, the desires strange, and the hopes extraneous. For the hope of the fool is to be rewarded with a very lowly reward when he happens to do one of the commandments. As he would only do a commandment when [its] value is not foreign to him, since he does not recognize the virtue of its performance as he cannot recognize its true supernal reward.

But the hope of the sage is one alone in everything that he hopes to be rewarded for it; and that is more wisdom every single day. And when it comes to him every day, he appreciates that God is granting him a great reward, as He strengthens his very soul and constantly raises it up from one thing to another and from one reward to another. And is the first reward not that God strengthens his heart and his effort to hunger for wisdom and hungrily hope to become wise by way of his great efforts and his diligent study according to that which it is fitting to study at the times that he has fixed to study wisdom? Hence when you see someone who hungers to know the truth for the honor of truthful elevation, it is impossible that his hunger will not burn with the fire of hunger when he studies the Sefer HeHoshek [The Book of the Hungry One, a reference to Sefer HaHeshek], which fires up the hearts of the lovers of God. And their reward will be great in the increase of the flow of the existence of wisdom for which they hunger. All the more so, when it comes to prophetic wisdom which are taught by the [divine] names that orchestrate reality, like those that we have hinted to in the first section, and which I will further hint to in these two sections.
Part II: And I, myself, do not know how to mention Him in my book. If it is with masculine wording – that is false, since it does not fit it. If it is with feminine wording – God forbid, since it is untrue, for it is not wording that fits God. But, if so, there is no way to speak about His essence truthfully. For anything that we will say about Him is rooted in our wording. And would it only be that, if it is a vain prayer, we not err in our minds about His essence, in the same way that we do not in some of His emanations, some of His names, His attributes, His ways, His descriptions, and His actions. All the more so [should we be careful] about His essence, with that which we have no way of grasping from any angle. And, if so, trifurcation is the flow that flows from Him the first; and all of His actions are trifurcated, and also fourthed, fifthed, cloned [further], and made composite like the example of the complexity of the sefirot that can be recognized in the letters.

Since God has made all this known to you, in that you are contemplating His work with your understanding, there is none so discerning and wise as you [alluding to Genesis 41:39]. And behold, if you do seek Him, He will make Himself present for you. But if you leave Him, He will forsake you forever. And likewise is it written, the Lord is with you as long as you are with Him. If you turn to Him, He will make Himself present for you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you (II Chronicles 15:2). And his final request and demand from us: He said that the attainment of prophecy which he spoke to us about is an easy way to grasp His conception, may He be blessed; all of it is actually through the combination of the letters, which itself is a way to know His names and to know His traits. And God made him know that He began all of his deeds with them and ended His work with them, and we have endless Torah proofs about this.
